sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful: it requires the supplied SOLAS chapter I certification boolean on each ship and restricts the chapter 9 applicability guard to ships whose certification value is true, without inventing or requiring an independent applicability property. Targets, canonical namespace, datatype, comparison direction, and deterministic validation are correct.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Do not introduce or depend on the convenience boolean nltl:polarCodeChapter9Applicable: the verified ship certification status already determines chapter 9 applicability. Rewrite the constraint to derive applicability directly from nltl:solasChapterICertified, preserving the stated one-way semantics and avoiding an independent applicability fact.
